use_case: Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) estimation from US-20 handheld ultrasound images (AI-enabled device software function, image analysis)
business_owner: Chief Medical Officer (clinical); Chief Technology Officer (development)
vendor_or_model: Company-built convolutional model, locked; runs in the US-20 tablet app; images archived in the DDC
data_categories: Ultrasound cine clips; age and sex for subgroup analysis; production images are PHI held for hospitals
human_in_the_loop: Clinician acquires images, reviews the estimate and a quality indicator, and makes the diagnosis; the tool never reports without an image-quality gate
applicable_laws: FD&C Act device requirements and QMSR design controls (21 CFR 820.10(c)); FD&C Act 524B (N31-33-R05); HIPAA Security Rule for archived images (N62-R01); FTC Act Section 5 (claims); hospitals' duties under 45 CFR 92.210
protected_characteristic_inputs: Age and sex used only for subgroup analysis, not as model inputs; body habitus affects image quality
bias_testing_status: Held-out internal testing done; subgroup gap for BMI 35 or more (POAM-025)
monitoring: Quarterly subgroup error after release; image-quality rejection rate by site

use_case: ECG arrhythmia detection in the RCM platform (flags events for technician review)
vendor_or_model: Company-built model, locked; part of the CR-100 system
data_categories: ECG signals; event annotations (PHI held for practices)
human_in_the_loop: Certified technicians review every flagged event and a random sample of unflagged data before any report
applicable_laws: FD&C Act device requirements (cleared with CR-100); 524B (CR-100 submitted after it took effect); HIPAA (N62-R01); practices' duties under 45 CFR 92.210
fda_regulatory_status: Cleared 2023-09 as part of the CR-100 system
protected_characteristic_inputs: None as inputs; performance may vary by age and sex
bias_testing_status: Overall monitoring; subgroup monitoring gap (SOC 2 PI1.3)
monitoring: Monthly sensitivity against technician review; quarterly subgroup review from 2027 Q1
